card.name: Milonga
card.tagline: Fast, syncopated precursor and cousin of tango.
card.profile: Milonga is a music genre and partner dance that originated in the Río de la Plata around the 1870s, derived from the payada de contrapunto and an 'excited habanera,' with strong Afro-Argentine candombe influence. The dance uses the same elements as tango but is faster, more relaxed and humorous, with rhythmic walking; styles include milonga lisa (step on every beat) and milonga con traspié (syncopated double steps) (English Wikipedia). It is considered a precursor of tango.
card.insight: Milonga is a foundational root of tango and a living part of the tango tradition; the word derives from an African (Kimbundu/Ki-Kongo) term, reflecting tango's Afro-Argentine origins (English Wikipedia; Robert Farris Thompson).
